checks.ref:
command:branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
if [ ! -f "$dir/review-code.md" ]; then
  echo "no audit report at $dir/review-code.md - write it before finishing the round, see .gnomish/stages/review-code/instructions.md"
  exit 1
fi

command:branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
report=$dir/review-code.md
expected=$(sed -n 's/^Change:[[:space:]]*//p' "$dir/change.md" | head -1)
change=$(sed -n 's/^## Implementation Audit:[[:space:]]*//p' "$report" | head -1 | tr -d '`')
if [ "$change" != "$expected" ]; then
  echo "the report's '## Implementation Audit:' heading names '$change', but this task's change is '$expected' - audit that change and name it exactly"
  exit 1
fi
for section in '### Summary' '### Tasks' '### Requirements' '### Project rules' '### Code quality' '### Test quality' '### Security' '### Recommendations, ordered' '### Verdict'; do
  grep -q "^$section" "$report" || { echo "the report has no '$section' section - keep the layout of step 9 of .claude/commands/audit-implementation.md"; exit 1; }
done
section() { awk -v heading="$1" 'index($0, heading) == 1 { inside = 1; next } /^##/ { inside = 0 } inside' "$report"; }
recommendations=$(section '### Recommendations, ordered')
items=$(printf '%s\n' "$recommendations" | grep -cE '^[0-9]+\. \*\*(CRITICAL|WARNING|SUGGESTION) — ' || true)
for field in Problem Impact Fix 'Fix risk'; do
  count=$(printf '%s\n' "$recommendations" | grep -cE "^[[:space:]]+$field: " || true)
  if [ "$count" != "$items" ]; then
    echo "Recommendations has $items item(s) of the form 'N. **SEVERITY — title** (\`location\`)' but $count indented '$field:' line(s) - every item carries one Problem, Impact, Fix and Fix risk line each, as .claude/rules/review-recommendations.md shows"
    exit 1
  fi
done
# Emphasis and case are tolerated: a usable verdict is not worth a round over markup.
verdict=$(section '### Verdict' | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' | head -1 | tr -d '*_`' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
blocking=$(printf '%s\n' "$recommendations" | grep -cE '^[0-9]+\. \*\*(CRITICAL|WARNING) — ' || true)
case "$verdict" in
  "not ready"*) [ "$blocking" -gt 0 ] || { echo "the Verdict reads 'not ready' but no recommendation is CRITICAL or WARNING - the Verdict opens with 'ready to archive'"; exit 1; } ;;
  "ready to archive"*) [ "$blocking" -eq 0 ] || { echo "there are $blocking CRITICAL/WARNING recommendation(s), so the Verdict opens with 'not ready', not 'ready to archive'"; exit 1; } ;;
  *) echo "the Verdict section opens with '$verdict'; it must open with exactly 'ready to archive' or 'not ready'"; exit 1 ;;
esac

command:branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
dirty=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | sed 's/^...//' | grep -vxF "$dir/review-code.md" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
if [ -n "$dirty" ]; then
  echo "this stage writes only $dir/review-code.md, but the working copy also carries:"
  echo "$dirty"
  echo "if you made these edits, undo each of them yourself and nothing else - an audit changes nothing; its recommendations are for the next stage."
  echo "if you did not: leave every one of them exactly as it is - do not stash, restore, checkout or clean anything - and escalate through \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE naming the paths."
  exit 1
fi

findings.message: R4: remove — fails tests 1, 2 and 4. The delta requirement 'The answer instruction is the dialect's' (agent-executor/spec.md:74-78) is scoped to the transform request's decision-asking form, not to the verdict shape; the report itself says no wrong verdict follows; and the proposed Fix is harmful: ClaudeDialect.answerForm(role) returns ClaudeAnswerSchema.FORM for every role, whose instruction describes the transform schema ('outcome' = 'decision_request'), so appending it to the judge prompt tells the judge to reply in a shape its own verdict schema rejects. Fix risk omits this.

R5: remove or rewrite — fails tests 1 and 4. The Problem claims no caller in main or test sources, but ContainerEnvironmentsSpec.groovy:25-27,163, ImageInspectionCountSpec.groovy:83 and RoleBoxDeclaredVolumesSpec.groovy:58 call judgeEnvironment(); 'Fix risk: none; no caller' is false, since deleting the method breaks three specs that must be adjusted or removed with it.

findings.message: R1: Fix fails test 4 (No harm). It prescribes a declared pair (manual-sync-pairs.md preference 2) on the premise that domain and adapters/agent share no classpath, but CommandStageExecutor.java:7 already imports domain.pipeline.BuiltInExecutors, so preference 1 (one owner of the command built-in's roles in domain, read by both the describe and JudgeRoleRule) applies; the rule allows a declared pair only across a classpath barrier. The finding itself (JudgeRoleRule.java:36 vs CommandStageExecutor.java:80, no marker, no identity spec) is valid; rewrite the Fix as a shared owner, not a marker plus identity spec.

findings.message: R2: remove as a fix-stage recommendation (fails test 4). The Fix refuses roundTimeout 0 at load, but design D6 (design.md:195) and task 2.3 (tasks.md:38-39) pin 'exactly the shapes accepted today', RoundTimeoutSpec:59-60 pins that set, and implement.md:39 already records this as 'a decision for review'. FR13/UX1 cover missing blocks, models and unsupported roles, not value ranges. It is a question for the human, not an edit; the Fix risk omits the D6 wording.

R3: Fix part (c) fails test 4 — moving PendingPoll.persisted (PendingPoll.java:195-203) into PendingEntries turns the `persistence` field into a parameter of a static method, the fields-into-parameters split process-invariants.md forbids, and gives a pure judgement class (PendingEntries.java:8-15) a branch write. Fix part (a) claims it brings SnapshotTipCheck under the cap, but SnapshotTipCheck already delegates the parse to RoundSubject.parse (:141) and loses no lines. Fix risk 'No behaviour changes' hides both. Keep the WARNING, rewrite the Fix.
